output.intervention: Weight-loss diets including very-low-energy diets, formula meal replacements, low-carbohydrate diets, and total diet replacement programs
output.outcome: Weight loss and type 2 diabetes remission
output.effect: Very-low-energy diets of 400-500 kcal for 8-12 weeks achieved 6.6 kg greater weight loss than low-energy diets; formula meal replacements achieved 2.4 kg greater weight loss; low-carbohydrate diets were no better than higher-carbohydrate or low-fat diets; total diet replacement programs had the strongest remission evidence, with median 54% remission at 1 year in relevant randomized trials.
output.applicability_boundary: Most evidence was limited to 1 year or less and review quality and GRADE certainty varied substantially.
